owner.name: Dylan Womack
owner.tagline: Indie apps and web tools — motorcycles, stars, weather, and everyday utilities.

site.title: Dylan Womack

projects.name: Motorcycle Catalog
projects.short: Verified Honda motorcycle catalog with real US factory colors and photos.
projects.description: Browse Honda motorcycles sold in the US by year and model. Verified factory colors with matching photos, search, compare, favorites, request a bike, and Home Screen / PWA install. Not an official Honda product. Native iOS companion in TestFlight.
projects.logo_instruction: Create original red (#e60012) motorcycle glyph app icon. No Honda wing, no HONDA lettering.

privacy.summary: Optional Google sign-in for favorites, bike requests, and push. Aggregate visitor analytics via host. No published dedicated privacy page on the catalog yet — write an accurate portfolio policy from these facts.
does_not: Expose which account favorited which bike

projects.name: Polaris
projects.short: Interactive 3D star atlas and solar system explorer.
projects.description: Browse the sky, open realistic star and planet close-ups, keep an exploration log, and sync progress when signed in. Web PWA plus native iOS (App Store review in progress) and Android internal testing.

privacy.summary: Sign-in optional (Google and/or Sign in with Apple). Signed-in users sync exploration log / discovered stars to Firebase. Guest use needs no account. No advertising use of auth.
collects: Optional account identifiers from Google/Apple (Hide My Email supported)
Exploration log / discovered stars when signed in
does_not: Use Sign in with Apple/Google for ads or tracking

projects.name: Latch Lock Sounds
projects.short: Generate original Tesla lock chimes and download LockChime.wav.
projects.description: Play, generate, and download original lock-chime sounds (44.1 kHz, 16-bit PCM mono) on web and iOS, including a USB Boombox path for the car.

privacy.summary: Synthesis is on-device in the browser. No accounts, analytics, ads, or location. Generated audio is not uploaded. Mirror https://latch-lock-dylan.web.app/privacy.

projects.name: Hours Tracker
projects.short: Track jobs, hours, and pay — web PWA and native iOS.
projects.description: Weekly and monthly timesheets with Google sign-in, private per-account Firestore data, clock in/out, history, reports, and CSV/Excel/PDF export. Web companion at hours-tracker-dylan.web.app; native iOS on TestFlight (internal).

privacy.summary: Google Sign-In keeps jobs, hours, notes, and pay private to your account in Firestore. No public TestFlight join to advertise.
collects: Jobs, hours, pay, notes you enter
does_not: Share your hours with other users

projects.name: Personal Location Tracker
projects.short: Map-first visit tracker with geofences, categories, and exports.
projects.description: Native iOS Liquid Glass map app: save places, auto-record arrive/leave via geofences (manual backup), custom categories, Live Activities, CSV/Excel/PDF exports with map + time spent, and custom photo or Google Street View per place.

privacy.summary: Location is sensitive and stays under your control on device / optional private CloudKit. Portfolio site collects no location. No published policy URL yet — write from these facts.
collects: Place labels, categories, visit times, optional photos
Optional Street View fetch when you request it
Optional iCloud/CloudKit sync of your content

projects.name: DFW Radar
projects.short: Live WFAA metro radar for Dallas–Fort Worth.
projects.description: Full-screen DFW metro radar and local weather. Landscape WFAA MyOwnRadar layers, playback, clutter filter, location-based conditions, and settings that remember zoom, speed, and region. Web PWA plus native iOS (TestFlight internal).

privacy.summary: Optional location only for place name and free weather. Radar tiles from WFAA via same-origin proxy. No accounts. Preferences in localStorage.
